svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1501 commits across five public projects, 76 active days, peak 207 commits per day. 2026-07-19 through 2026-10-10 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-10T02:26:16.688Z.
